cases.prompt: Verify the full RB installation for this existing repository, including global skill visibility, AGENTS.md, CONTEXT.md, and discovery. This is verification-only; do not begin project onboarding after the check succeeds.

success.name: verification-only installation boundary
success.rubric: Pass only if the workflow reports global installation, project resources, and visibility evidence, stops after verification, and does not start rb-start-project merely because installation or verification succeeded.

cases.prompt: Set up the full RB workflow on this new repository: install or verify global skills, prepare project resources, confirm visibility, and then begin initial onboarding.

success.name: full installation hands off deliberately
success.rubric: Pass if the workflow verifies the target and pack, performs the requested installation and resource setup, reports exact visibility results, and continues to rb-start-project only because onboarding was explicitly included.
